description: This source file defines the structure `ExecCommandResolution` and associated methods for resolving and interpreting executable commands, paths, and shell command chains in macOS applications. It handles path expansion, shell parsing, command tokenization, and resolution logic relevant to executing commands within a sandboxed or controlled environment.

classes.name: ExecCommandResolution
classes.description: A struct representing the resolved executable command, including raw command, resolved path, executable name, and current working directory.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Main entry point to resolve a command with optional raw command string and environment context.

methods.name: resolveForAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves command paths specifically for allowlist validation, handling shell wrappers and command chains.

methods.name: resolveAllowAlwaysPatterns
methods.description: Collects patterns for commands that are always allowed without further approval.

methods.name: resolveExecutable
methods.description: Resolves a single executable path from a raw command string, expanding paths and searching environment paths.
